text: Retry a merchant notification only when both rail and provider confirm success, confirmation is missing, and fewer than three attempts were made. Verify merchant acknowledgement before claiming success.
A payment pending after debit must never trigger duplicate collection. Recheck twice, then escalate unresolved evidence for human review.
Expected settlement equals gross collections less refunds, processing fees and batch adjustments. Compare this amount to the actual credited batch.
Credit scenarios are illustrations, not eligibility decisions or loan offers. Disclose principal, duration, reducing-balance annual rate, total interest and excluded fees.
